summary.headline: Post-Labor Day surge: HIH +323% and MQL +167% -- largest single-week top-of-funnel spike of the year. Inkwell drove 71% of high-intent activity.
summary.body: W38 (Sep 14-20) delivered the sharpest top-of-funnel acceleration of 2026: HIH at 55 exceeded 2.5x the 8-week rolling median, MQL reached 128, and SQL/Opp each hit 24 -- all triple-digit WoW gains after the Labor Day lull. Inkwell dominated new high-intent inbound (39/55 HIH), while Medium District led SQL conversion. DQ (275) and Nurture (114) surged proportionally, with no list event triggered. Pipeline stands at 31 district + 11 school open deals SY27-28.

brand_lift.note: These are Google Search numbers, not social engagement — how often our brand and channels surface when people search. YouTube and Instagram are Search Console platform properties, visible in the Search Console UI but not exposed by the Search Analytics API, so those tiles stay blank rather than showing a fabricated zero. LinkedIn has no GSC connector — it's owned by Microsoft and isn't integrated with Google. ⏳ The week of Sep 21 is still provisional: Google has finalized only 5 of its 7 days, so its full-week total (395 branded clicks) is understated and will revise upward on the next run. The WoW figure shown compares the same 5 settled days in each week, which is the like-for-like read; the full-week comparison would be misleading until the week settles.

current.narrative: W39 (Sep 21-27) delivered a sharp mean-reversion from last week’s post-Labor Day surge: HIH fell to 23 (-58% WoW 🚨), MQL to 76 (-41% 🚨), SQL to 17 (-29% 🚨), and Opp to 18 (-25% ⚠️). All four stages are below the prior 8-week median — likely a correction after an outsized W38, but a second consecutive down week would signal structural softening. Content engagement held: Inkwell ELA and K-5 SS led form fills (top 2 offers: 55 fills combined). Open pipeline: 130 NB + 3 AG + 291 Renewal + 33 District + 10 School deals. Two NB SY27-28 deals closed lost this week: Aptakisic-Tripp IL ($32.8K) and Norman PS OK ($110.2K).

previous.narrative: Post-Labor Day surge delivered the headline week: HIH jumped to 55 (+323% WoW), exceeding 2.5x the 8-week rolling median (28.75) -- consistent with back-to-school acceleration. MQL hit 128 (+167%) and SQL and Opp each reached 24 (+85%/+100%). Inkwell drove 71% of new high-intent activity (39 of 55 HIH). Medium District led SQL conversion (10 of 24). DQ surged to 275 (+202%) and Nurture to 114 (+235%), tracking with the top-of-funnel spike. Open pipeline: 31 district + 11 school deals SY27-28. Branded search at 434 clicks (-10% WoW provisional).
